name: Teen Titans Go!
description: Robin, Starfire, Raven, Beast Boy and Cyborg return in all-new, comedic adventures. They may be super heroes who save the world every day ... but somebody still has to do the laundry!

videos.title: The Dimensions Crisis
videos.overview: Raven transports herself and the Titans to the Lego world to explore and retrieve more bricks for Beast Boy and Cyborg to win the brick building contest.

videos.title: Top of the Titans: Raddest Songs
videos.overview: Birdarang counts down the top 12 "raddest" songs from the show.

videos.title: Top of the Titans: Best Love Songs
videos.overview: Birdarang counts down the top 9 love songs from the show.

videos.title: Top of the Titans: Beast Boy & Cyborg Songs
videos.overview: Birdarang counts down the top 14 Beast Boy and Cyborg songs from the show.

videos.title: Top of the Titans: Dance Party
videos.overview: Birdarang counts down the top 13 dance party songs from the show.

videos.title: Top of the Titans: Best Rivals
videos.overview: Robin counts down the top 15 rival moments from the show.

videos.title: Cartoon Network Special Edition: NBA All-Star Slam Dunk Contest Presented by Nike
videos.overview: Cartoon Network's version of the NBA Slam Dunk Contest, highlighting the best slam dunks, hosted by the Teen Titans.

videos.title: CN Special: NBA All-Star Slam Dunk Contest
videos.overview: Cartoon Network's version of the NBA Slam Dunk Contest, highlighting the best slam dunks, hosted by the Teen Titans.

videos.title: Legendary Sandwich
videos.overview: Beast Boy, Robin and Starfire go in search of the ingredients for a legendary sandwich.

videos.title: Pie Bros
videos.overview: Beast Boy gets a job at a pie shop in order to buy Cyborg a birthday gift.

videos.title: Driver's Ed
videos.overview: Robin takes driver's ed, and his teacher has some tricks up his sleeve.

videos.title: Dog Hand
videos.overview: Raven's dad cozies up to her friends in hopes of luring her over to the dark side.

videos.title: Double Trouble
videos.overview: Cyborg has Raven create doubles of himself and Beast Boy.

videos.title: The Date
videos.overview: To go on a date with Starfire, Robin kidnaps Speedy.

videos.title: Dude Relax!
videos.overview: The gang try to teach Robin to relax after his high-strung nature begins affecting the team. Later, chores pile up while the team bicker, and soon their dirty uniforms go on the offensive.

videos.title: Laundry Day
videos.overview: Later, chores pile up while the team bicker, and soon their dirty uniforms go on the offensive.

videos.title: Ghostboy
videos.overview: Beast Boy pretends to be a ghost haunting Starfire so she will do his bidding. When she figures out the ruse, she and the other Titans convince Beast Boy that he's actually dead.

videos.title: La Larva de Amor
videos.overview: Robin, Cyborg, Beast Boy, and Raven agree to take on the responsibility of babysitting Silkie while Starfire is away.

videos.title: Hey Pizza!
videos.overview: Cyborg and Beast Boy try to capitalize on Zippy's Pizza's "thirty minutes or its free" deal, but the delivery boy is seemingly unstoppable. It becomes a bit of a challenge as an all-out war of wits between them erupts. Meanwhile, Robin struggles with whether to build a senior center or a pool (leaning toward the pool mostly to see Starfire in a bikini).

videos.title: Gorilla
videos.overview: Beast Boy turns into a loud, obnoxious gorilla and refuses to change back driving Robin crazy. Gorilla Beast Boy takes over the leadership of the Titans leading to chaos ranging from not letting a girl get onto Beast Boy's monkey bars, fighting crocodiles, and freeing captive gorillas from the zoo. Cyborg teaches Robin how to be an alpha male so he can take back his role as leader of the Teen Titans.

videos.title: Girl's Night Out
videos.overview: When Robin, Cyborg, and Beast Boy won’t let Starfire and Raven come along on their "Boys' Night Out," Starfire and Raven spring Jinx from prison and the three of them have a wild night of their own.

videos.title: You're Fired!
videos.overview: Beast Boy's behavior causes him to be fired from the Teen Titans and replaced by a pair of shape-shifting twins.

videos.title: Super Robin
videos.overview: Envious of the other Titans' superpowers following their fight with the H.I.V.E. Five (consisting of Mammoth, Gizmo, Jinx, Billy Numerous, and See-More), Robin wants some of his own. After a disastrous scientific experiment goes awry that merges him with the DNA of the American Robin, he convinces Raven to use her magic to give him superpowers even though she claims that superpowers are a curse.

videos.title: Tower Power
videos.overview: Cyborg plugs into the control panel of the Titans tower and drives the others crazy.

videos.title: Parasite
videos.overview: Starfire's new pet is a horribly dangerous parasite, but Robin is the only one who is suspicious of the beast.

videos.title: Starliar
videos.overview: Beast Boy teaches Starfire how to lie and it backfires as her lies get more and more outrageous.

videos.title: Meatball Party
videos.overview: Raven eats a bad meatball that causes tentacles to spring from her teeth and devour the other Titans.

videos.title: Staff Meeting
videos.overview: When Robin's long bo-staff is accidentally broken by the other four Titans, he seeks a new one at the mystical Tree of the Universe.

videos.title: Terra-ized
videos.overview: When Beast Boy believes that Terra is his new beloved sweetheart and girlfriend, Raven is suspicious of her true motives.

videos.title: Artful Dodgers
videos.overview: The Titans believe they will win an upcoming dodgeball championship.

videos.title: Burger vs. Burrito
videos.overview: Cyborg and Beast Boy are in perfect sync, except when it comes to their taste in food. What’s the best food ever created, burgers or burritos? The two friends have an all-out competition to settle things once and for all.

videos.title: Matched
videos.overview: Cyborg’s Love Matcher 5000 program pairs Raven with Beast Boy and Starfire with Aquaman. While Beast Boy does everything he can to get Raven to love him, Robin tries to be more like Aquaman to win Starfire’s heart.

videos.title: Colors of Raven
videos.overview: A magical prism causes Raven to fragment into five distinct personalities which wreak havoc around town until the other Titans can figure out how to rejoin her.

videos.title: The Left Leg
videos.overview: When the gang bands together to form a giant robot, Robin is relegated to the left leg, but he makes the left leg count!

videos.title: Books
videos.overview: The Titans discover the wonders of reading, but after opening a book that brings their thoughts to life, they must fight against their own imaginations!

videos.title: Lazy Sunday
videos.overview: Cyborg and Beast Boy love lazy Sundays sitting on the couch … even when it’s a Tuesday! But when Robin replaces the couch with a treadmill, the two lazy teens must embrace the new active lifestyle.

videos.title: Starfire the Terrible
videos.overview: When Robin needs an archenemy, Starfire generously offers to fill the role and she exceeds expectations.

videos.title: Power Moves
videos.overview: When Robin starts doing power moves with Cyborg, Beast Boy gets very jealous.

videos.title: Staring at the Future
videos.overview: Cyborg and Beast Boy have a staring contest that lasts 30 years, bringing them face to face with a future of adulthood and responsibility… and they hate it.

videos.title: No Power
videos.overview: Feeling the other Titans depend too much on their super powers, Robin challenges them to go 24 hours without using their powers. To his distress, they all succeed, leading him to question his own value to the team.

videos.title: Sidekick
videos.overview: Robin gets called back to the Batcave but only as a house-sitter while Batman’s away.

videos.title: Caged Tiger
videos.overview: Cyborg, Beast Boy, and Robin return from a Bro-cation closer than ever, but their bro-mentum is interrupted by Dr. Light!

videos.title: Second Christmas
videos.overview: The Titans trick Starfire into believing in second Christmas with a second Santa.

videos.title: Nose Mouth
videos.overview: Raven's past powers may cause consequences to the other Titans.

videos.title: Legs
videos.overview: After Robin swipes her cloak, Raven's leggy figure is revealed and she transforms into Lady Legasus. Meanwhile, Cyborg gets stuck in the discarded cloak, revealing a dark side of his personality.

videos.title: Breakfast Cheese
videos.overview: Starfire convinces the reluctant Titans to try defeating their enemies with compassion rather than violence.

videos.title: Waffles
videos.overview: Cyborg and Beast Boy show their love of waffles by making it the only word they say, much to the annoyance of the other Titans.

videos.title: Be Mine
videos.overview: It's Valentine's Day, and the Titans are throwing a dance. Beast Boy knows who he wants to go with, and thing is... he wants to go with Terra, his ex-girlfriend, who already made a crack at eliminating the Titans.

videos.title: Opposites
videos.overview: Cyborg has a crush on Jinx.

videos.title: Birds
videos.overview: Robin removes two mockingbirds from the chimney with a gas he created in his lab. But the chemical mutates the birds into muscular bullies who then move into the tower.

videos.title: Brain Food
videos.overview: Beast Boy is tired of being the least intelligent of the Titans. When all of his efforts to get smart fail, he uses Raven's spell book to cast a spell - not to make him smarter, but to make all of the other Titans dumber.

videos.title: In and Out
videos.overview: Robin infiltrates the H.I.V.E. Tower to destroy it, but instead he is distracted by its awesomeness!

videos.title: Little Buddies
videos.overview: Cyborg wants Pain Bot to be his "little buddy" but is the destructive robot too dangerous to be a sidekick?

videos.title: Missing
videos.overview: Killer Moth offers a reward for Silkie's return, but will Silkie be happier away from the Titans?

videos.title: Uncle Jokes
videos.overview: Starfire is allowed to join Beast Boy and Cyborg's revelry, if she avoids uncle jokes.

videos.title: Mas Y Menos
videos.overview: Robin tries to teach Spanish-speaking brothers his superhero ways.

videos.title: Dreams
videos.overview: The dream worlds of the Titans.

videos.title: Grandma Voice
videos.overview: Cyborg is possessed by a "Grandma Voice", which irritates the Titans.

videos.title: Real Magic
videos.overview: Robin dabbles with magic, ignoring Raven's warning that he will anger the magic god.

videos.title: Puppets, Whaaaaat?
videos.overview: Robin makes a deal with a sock puppet which turns him and the other titans into puppets.

videos.title: Mr. Butt
videos.overview: Blackfire pays a surprise visit to her sister Starfire, saying she wants to spend some quality time with her. The other Titans think that Blackfire is playing another trick, but Starfire is sure that this time Blackfire is serious about reviving their sisterly love

videos.title: Man Person
videos.overview: Despite the Titans' protests, Beast Boy becomes convinced that replacing his body parts with robotic limbs makes him more manly.

videos.title: Pirates
videos.overview: Aqualad asks Raven out on a date, which makes Beast Boy jealous. Cyborg tries to prove that Aqualad is really a pirate.

videos.title: Money Grandma
videos.overview: When Robin starts a smear campaign against all of the other Titans so that he can be re-elected  Team Leader, Raven uses a time machine to bring a great leader from the past to teach Robin how to lead.

videos.title: I See You
videos.overview: Robin brings Starfire on a fake stakeout in an attempt to get a kiss, while Cyborg and Beast Boy hold their own stakeout to discover Raven's dark secret.

videos.title: Brian
videos.overview: When the Brain captures the Titans to fuel Project B.R.I.A.N., the Titans' little buddies are the only heroes who can save them.

videos.title: Nature
videos.overview: When Beast Boy loses his ability to change into animals, he realizes that he’s lost touch with his wild side. He goes to the forest to reconnect with his inner beast, but Mother Nature isn't as great as he had hoped.

videos.title: Salty Codgers
videos.overview: Raven is delighted when the other Titans are magically turned into old people during a battle.

videos.title: Knowledge
videos.overview: Starfire wants to learn more, but will knowledge make her a bummer?

videos.title: Slumber Party
videos.overview: When the other Titans find out that Cyborg is afraid of the dark, they have a slumber party to help him face his fears.

videos.title: Love Monsters
videos.overview: Raven warns the Titans not to go near a box containing the Twin Destroyers of Azarath. Starfire can't help it and opens the box, giving hugs and snuggles to the tiny and adorable destroyers... but love only makes the destroyers stronger. Now, the Titans must find a way to get the monsters back in the box before Raven finds out that they were released.

videos.title: Baby Hands
videos.overview: Robin has been hiding something under his gloves.

videos.title: Caramel Apples
videos.overview: Raven and Starfire clash after Starfire creates a bond with Raven's father, while Robin, Cyborg, and Beast Boy struggle to return to Earth's surface after falling into a deep cavern.

videos.title: Sandwich Thief
videos.overview: Robin's perfect sandwich is missing and he will stop at nothing to find it.

videos.title: Friendship
videos.overview: When Control Freak imprisons the Titans in a Pretty Pretty Pegasus world, the Titans decide to use violence to escape, while Raven decides to use friendship and happiness.

videos.title: Vegetables
videos.overview: When the team tries to live a vegetarian lifestyle, they learn that living that way is not for everyone.

videos.title: The Mask
videos.overview: Robin's mask hides both his secret identity and a horrible secret.

videos.title: Serious Business
videos.overview: When Robin rations bathroom time to five minutes per visit, the other Titans try to show him the magic of the bathroom.

videos.title: Halloween
videos.overview: Raven tries to get the other titans to enjoy Halloween again.

videos.title: Boys vs Girls
videos.overview: The Titans compete against each other to prove who is the better gender.

videos.title: Body Adventure
videos.overview: Cyborg is infected with a cold and the Titans shrink down to fight it off.

videos.title: Road Trip
videos.overview: Cyborg completely rebuilt the T-Car and takes it out on a road trip.

videos.title: Thanksgiving
videos.overview: When Raven’s father Trigon shows up for Thanksgiving dinner, Robin’s seating plan isn't the only thing that gets ruined.

videos.title: The Best Robin
videos.overview: Due to the Titans' laziness, Robin creates another team of himself to battle Brother Blood.

videos.title: Mouth Hole
videos.overview: Robin wants to gain the power of whistling.

videos.title: Hot Garbage
videos.overview: The Titans try to convince Beast Boy to clean his room, but they learn that there is more to garbage than just trash.

videos.title: Robin Backwards
videos.overview: When Nibor, Bizzaro World's Robin, arrives in Jump City, the team decides that they should watch him.

videos.title: Crazy Day
videos.overview: When Crazy Day arrives, Raven tries to avoid being driven crazy by her fellow teammates.

videos.title: Smile Bones
videos.overview: When Cyborg and Beast Boy teach the others to wolf down their food, the group must battle their own obesity.

videos.title: Real Boy Adventures
videos.overview: After transforming himself into 'Fleshy Guy', Cyborg discovers the delight and agony of being human.

videos.title: Hose Water
videos.overview: The discovery of a baby bird fuels Starfire and Cyborg to discover their inner children have been awakened.

videos.title: Let's Get Serious
videos.overview: Robin attempts to make the Teen Titans to be taken more seriously by the real heroes from Young Justice.

videos.title: Tamaranian Vacation
videos.overview: The Titans visit Starfire's home world of Tamaran to try and learn what makes her so sweet and loving.

videos.title: Rocks and Water
videos.overview: Raven and Beast Boy are surprised to discover that their exes, Terra and Aqualad, are dating each other.

videos.title: Multiple Trick Pony
videos.overview: Robin insists that he is a 'multiple trick pony.'

videos.title: Truth, Justice and What?
videos.overview: Pizza is the source of the Titans' goofy humor.

videos.title: Two Bumble Bees and a Wasp
videos.overview: When Robin tries to teach the others to have more respect for money, he ends up learning a lesson.

videos.title: Oil Drums
videos.overview: Cyborg is looking forward to a marathon of '80s television shows, but the remote appears to be missing.

videos.title: Video Game References
videos.overview: The Titans immerse themselves into a variety of video game worlds.

videos.title: Cool School
videos.overview: Raven decides to hang out with Rose Wilson because she is cool; the others believe they are lame by comparison so they attend Cool School.

videos.title: Kicking a Ball and Pretending to Be Hurt
videos.overview: The Titans learn about the magic of soccer.

videos.title: Head Fruit
videos.overview: When Beast Boy's head starts to rattle, Robin suggests that he should find a hobby so that his brain will stop shrinking.

videos.title: Yearbook Madness
videos.overview: Beast Boy and Cyborg decide to create a yearbook for the Titans.

videos.title: Beast Man
videos.overview: Beast Boy discovers he can transform into an adult man.

videos.title: Operation Tin Man
videos.overview: Gizmo convinces the Titans he's kidnapped Cyborg, when in reality Cyborg's just hanging out in the HIVE tower with his girl Jinx. When Gizmo gets annoyed by Cyborg's constant presence, the two start a prank war.

videos.title: Nean
videos.overview: Raven is cursed to be nice; meanwhile, Starfire is about to marry a pot of chili.

videos.title: Campfire Stories
videos.overview: The Titans are having a terrible time on their camping trip, so Robin suggests that they each tell a scary campfire story.

videos.title: And the Award for Sound Design Goes to Rob
videos.overview: Raven just wants some piece and quiet for once, and accidentally makes a magical deal that eliminates all sounds.

videos.title: The HIVE Five
videos.overview: The HIVE decides to take the day off so that they can avoid engaging with the Titans, if it is possible.

videos.title: The Return of Slade
videos.overview: Beast Boy and Cyborg insist on hiring a clown for a Titans party, even though Robin tells them that clowns are for little kids. When the clown fails to live up to their memories, Cyborg and Beast Boy decide to give the clown some cool updates.

videos.title: More of the Same
videos.overview: Can the Titans master the four New Year's traditions in order to break the cycle of bad years?

videos.title: Some of Their Parts
videos.overview: Robin uses the prism to split the Titans into five parts so he can pick out the best ones for the team.

videos.title: Cat's Fancy
videos.overview: Robin is determined to become a cat in order to get Starfire's attention.

videos.title: Leg Day
videos.overview: After a humiliating defeat, Raven and the Titans work on building their lower body strength, becoming the "League of Legs."

videos.title: Dignity of Teeth
videos.overview: After Beast Boy gets money from the Tooth Fairy, the other Titans try to get in on the action by knocking out their own teeth.

videos.title: Croissant
videos.overview: After learning looks don't matter, Beast Boy undergoes a metamorphosis through a cocoon, becoming an ugly, gross creature.

videos.title: Spice Game
videos.overview: Having grown sick of Robin's bland cooking, the other Titans make attempts to spice things up.

videos.title: I'm the Sauce
videos.overview: Stuck inside on a rainy day, the Titans do rainy-day activities to keep from boredom.

videos.title: Hey You, Don't Forget About Me In Your Memory
videos.overview: When Robin decides to become an all-American class president-type person, he convinces the Titans to return to school with him.

videos.title: Accept The Next Proposition You Hear
videos.overview: Robin refuses to give the Titans any more orders so that they'll learn to think for themselves.

videos.title: The Fourth Wall
videos.overview: Control Freak informs the Titans that they are on a TV show he created and demands they earn him an award.
Cyborg's real strength comes not from his robot parts, but from his favorite song.

videos.title: Grube's Fairytales
videos.overview: Robin tries to teach the Titans valuable life lessons by reading them fairytales, but the others co-opt his stories and spin them into their own twisted yarns.

videos.title: A Farce
videos.overview: The titans are brought to court for the destruction they caused to Jump City.

videos.title: Scary Figure Dance
videos.overview: The Hive succeed in destroying the Titans, but their ghosts come back to haunt them all.

videos.title: Animals, It's Just a Word!
videos.overview: Beast Boy's presses the fire button on Cyborg's laser cannon and the Titans die, but Beast Boy puts his blood in them to save them from dying and now have the ability to transform into animals and act like animals.

videos.title: BBBDay!
videos.overview: It's Beast Boy's birthday, but no one will celebrate it.

videos.title: Black Friday
videos.overview: After refusing to shop on Black Friday, Starfire is visited by the ghosts of Black Friday past, present, and future.

videos.title: Two Parter (1)
videos.overview: The Titans visit the Hall of Justice to use the pool, but then decided to check out the inside.

videos.title: Two Parter (2)
videos.overview: The Titans must save the members of the Justice League from the clutches of the supervillan Darkseid.

videos.title: The True Meaning of Christmas
videos.overview: The Titans attempt to infiltrate Santa's workshop to get their names taken off the Naughty List.

videos.title: Squash & Stretch
videos.overview: The Titans learn about cartoon-style violence while trying to get back a bowl of nuts from a Sqirrel.

videos.title: Garage Sale
videos.overview: Robin makes the other Titans sell their treasured mementos from past episodes.

videos.title: Secret Garden
videos.overview: Cyborg is building stress up, to the point where he directs his built-up rage onto the other Titans. To help calm him down, Starfire takes Cyborg into her own, little secret garden.

videos.title: The Cruel Giggling Ghoul
videos.overview: The Titans go to watch Lebron James at the Wacka Doodles Amusement Park, but find no one is there.

videos.title: How 'Bout Some Effort
videos.overview: It's Valentine's Day and Cyborg goes to great lengths to make it special for his girlfriend Jinx.

videos.title: Pyramid Scheme
videos.overview: Beast Boy makes lots of money due to a pyramid scheme and convinces the other Titans to join in.

videos.title: Beast Boy's St. Patrick's Day Luck, and it's Bad
videos.overview: Beast Boy pinches the other Titans on St. Patty's Day, making them pinch him back, resulting in them all getting curse with bad luck.

videos.title: The Teen Titans Go Easter Holiday Classic
videos.overview: The Easter Bunny is missing, and it's up to the Titans to find him before Easter is ruined.

videos.title: Batman v Teen Titans: Dark Injustice
videos.overview: The Titans try to outprank each other on April Fools' Day.

videos.title: Bottle Episode
videos.overview: After they are trapped in a giant bottle in their living room, the Titans reminisce to pass the time.

videos.title: Finally a Lesson
videos.overview: Robin is able to teach the other Titans a very valuable lesson.

videos.title: Arms Race with Legs
videos.overview: Lady Legasus must stop the League of Legs.

videos.title: Obinray
videos.overview: In order to prevent Robin from eavesdropping, the other Titans begin communicating in Pig Latin.

videos.title: Wally T
videos.overview: Wally T., a fan of the Teen Titans, visits the tower, powering up all the Titans; making them want to get more fans to power up even more.

videos.title: Rad Dudes with Bad Tudes
videos.overview: Robin tries to emulate rollerbladers.

videos.title: Operation Dude Rescue (1)
videos.overview: When Robin, Beast Boy and Cyborg are captured, Starfire and Raven must find extra girl power to rescue them.

videos.title: Operation Dude Rescue (2)
videos.overview: Female heroes and villains all work together in order to rescue Robin, Cyborg and Beast Boy from The Brain.

videos.title: History Lesson
videos.overview: Robin tries to teach the other Titans about world history, but they tell their tales of history instead.

videos.title: The Art of Ninjutsu
videos.overview: The Titans must use ninjutsu to get the McGuffin.

videos.title: Think About Your Future
videos.overview: The future Teen Titans travel back in time to stop their young selves from ruining their lives financially and medically.

videos.title: TTG v PPG
videos.overview: After using a repellent to temporarily prevent the Powerpuff Girls from moving, Mojo Jojo uses a teleportation device to teleport himself into Jump City, in the Titans' tower, then the girls follow him into the same place where he appeared, only to run into Robin, Starfire, and Raven. Then, after the girls compete with three of the Titans to see who's better, and Mojo Jojo traps Cyborg and Beast Boy in his new lair, the girls defeat him, with "help" from Robin, Starfire, and Raven.

videos.title: Island Adventures (1): Coconut Cream Pie
videos.overview: The Titans are shipwrecked on a desert island and must use the island's resources to survive.

videos.title: Island Adventures (2): Pure Protein
videos.overview: The Titans hold a team competition, but have to avoid an alien hunter.

videos.title: Island Adventures (3): Open Door Policy
videos.overview: Still shipwrecked on a desert island, the Titans try to find food but stumble upon dinosaurs instead.

videos.title: Island Adventures (4): Crazy Desire Island
videos.overview: Robin eavesdrops on the Titans and grant them wishes to teach them life lessons, but things didn't go as he hoped.

videos.title: Island Adventures (5): The Titans Show
videos.overview: The Titans get sick of the island and decide to leave, only to realize that they have in fact been unknowingly press-ganged into a reality TV show by the Teen Titans villains and Control Freak.

videos.title: Booty Scooty
videos.overview: In order to save Titans Tower from some wealthy land developers, the Titans search for pirate treasure.

videos.title: Who's Laughing Now
videos.overview: Beast Boy searches for his spirit animal and joins a group of bears.

videos.title: Oregon Trail
videos.overview: The group gets into the pioneer spirit on their journey west.

videos.title: Snuggle Time
videos.overview: When yet another crime alert interrupts their relaxation, the Titans decide to become villains and do whatever they want.

videos.title: Oh Yeah!
videos.overview: Cyborg tells the other Titans that TV wrestling is fake and tries to teach them about real wrestling.

videos.title: Riding the Dragon
videos.overview: The Titans are transported inside a fantasy adventure game and must find the key to return home.

videos.title: The Overbite
videos.overview: Raven teaches the other Titans how to dance properly but then they are captured by the Dance Demon.

videos.title: The Cape
videos.overview: The Titans reminisce about the time they threw a surprise party for Cinderblock.

videos.title: Shrimps and Prime Rib
videos.overview: The Titans try to remember how to be superheroes in order to stop The Brain.

videos.title: Halloween v Christmas
videos.overview: When Santa tries to take over Halloween, it's up to the Titans and a few ghouls to stop him.

videos.title: Booby Trap House
videos.overview: Cyborg and Starfire booby-trap the Tower for safety.

videos.title: Fish Water
videos.overview: Starfire wins a goldfish at the carnival and vows to keep it alive.

videos.title: TV Knight
videos.overview: Batman and Commissioner Gordon check in on various happenings around Jump City.

videos.title: Teen Titans Save Christmas
videos.overview: When Santa decides to quit, the Titans pitch in to save Christmas.

videos.title: BBSFBDAY!
videos.overview: Beast Boy agrees to share his birthday with Starfire after learning she's never had one on Earth.

videos.title: The Streak (1)
videos.overview: Robin is determined to continue his streak of stopping 52 crimes during crime season.

videos.title: The Streak (2)
videos.overview: Robin's streak is in jeopardy when the other Titans are poached by Kid Flash.

videos.title: The Inner Beauty of a Cactus
videos.overview: The Titans play Spin The Bottle as Starfire tries to improve her vocabulary through kissing.

videos.title: Movie Night
videos.overview: The Titans have a hard time deciding who gets to choose which movie they watch on movie night.

videos.title: BBRAE (1)
videos.overview: Beast Boy writes a song for Raven to express his feelings, then begins touring with the song, which upsets Raven.

videos.title: BBRAE (2)
videos.overview: Beast Boy writes a song for Raven to express his feelings, then begins touring with the song, which upsets Raven.

videos.title: Permanent Record
videos.overview: It's back to school for the Titans as they teach each other about science and grammar.

videos.title: Titan Saving Time
videos.overview: The Titans are determined to find out what happened to the missing 2'oclock hour during Daylight Saving Time.

videos.title: The Gold Standard
videos.overview: It's St. Patrick's Day and after wishing to become a leprechaun, Beast Boy becomes obsessed with gold.

videos.title: Master Detective
videos.overview: Robin uses his skills as a master detective to discover what happened to the animals that live outside Titans Tower.

videos.title: Easter Creeps
videos.overview: The Tooth Fairy tries to take over Easter.

videos.title: Hand Zombie
videos.overview: After Starfire kisses his hand, Robin vows to never wash it again, which leads to disastrous results.

videos.title: Employee of the Month: Redux
videos.overview: The Titans battle a UFO that is snatching cows, while Beast Boy gets a job so he can save up for a moped.

videos.title: The Avogodo
videos.overview: Robin learns that avocados are a super food that can give you super powers.

videos.title: Orangins
